caption: 01 · SAMPLE — Is the comparison set honest?. Define seasons, object types, images, dates, sources, missing records, and selection criteria before describing a pattern. Do not cherry-pick only the most recognizable work.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

caption: 02 · CODE — What exactly recurs?. Code silhouette, proportion, material, construction, color, gesture, image, language, casting, and refusal as separate observable fields. Keep description distinct from interpretation.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what exactly recurs? within Seven Seasons of Signal.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

caption: 03 · EXCEPTION — What does change reveal?. Record deliberate departures, commercial compromises, collaborator interventions, technical limits, and failed experiments. Exceptions show whether the method governs more than a motif.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what does change reveal? within Seven Seasons of Signal.

caption: 04 · CLAIM — What may be said or protected?. Separate cultural recognition, creator testimony, trademark evidence, product-design trade dress, copyrightable expression, design rights, and unresolved legal questions. Route protection claims to jurisdiction-specific counsel.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
